description: USFS National Forest System trails (Trans_Trail_NFS_Publish) with per-mode managed-use flags and season windows. Stage 1: tileset built + published but NO client layer yet (hiking overlay is a later stage); the dataset also feeds the MVUM trail enrichment sidecar (surface/trail_class join by CN).
notes: Field names verified 2026-08-03 against EDW_TrailNFSPublish_01/0: trail_cn, trail_no, trail_name, trail_class, trail_surface, terra_motorized/snow_motorized/water_motorized, {mode}_managed season-string columns ('N/A' is the null sentinel), gis_miles. vehicle_flags mapping (motorized terra modes only): motorcycle_managed→moto, atv_managed→atv_lt50, fourwd_managed→fourwd_gt50, e_bike_classN_managed→ebikeN; snowmobile/snowcoach/motor_watercraft have no slot in the 17-key vocabulary and are excluded. designation: 'open' when terra_motorized='Y', else 'unassessed'.
